categories.main_business_segments: Evergrande Property Services operates primarily in four business segments: property management services, community living services, asset management services, and community operation services. The company provides diversified property management including residential, commercial, industrial parks, hospitals, schools, rail transit, and city public services. It also offers value-added services such as community group buying, housing rental and sales, and home entry services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages AIoT technology to develop intelligent security systems and smart community ecosystems integrating hardware, platforms, and services. It employs digital intelligence transformation for operational efficiency, including AI customer service, smart work order systems, and machine learning for process optimization. The company also invests in facility and equipment renewal, environmental enhancement, and greening upgrades to improve service quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Evergrande serves property owners and tenants across residential, commercial, industrial, hospital, school, rail transit, and city public service sectors. Key customers include property owners in first-tier cities and emerging city clusters, as well as major clients in energy, telecommunications, logistics, and consumption industries. The company also targets community residents for living services and group buying, and institutional clients for asset management.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group's operations are primarily located in the People's Republic of China, with a focus on first-tier cities and emerging city agglomerations. It manages properties across 237 cities and has headquarters in Guangzhou, Guangdong Province, with a principal place of business in Hong Kong. The company’s registered office is in the Cayman Islands.
categories.supply_chain_position: Evergrande Property Services operates primarily in the downstream segment of the property management supply chain, providing property management and related services directly to property owners and residents. It also engages in community living services and asset management, acting as a service provider and operator rather than a property developer or upstream supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include upgrading living experiences through excellent services, expanding innovative businesses driven by customer needs, and promoting diversified business formats for scale and quality growth. It emphasizes digital intelligence transformation integrating AI and IoT technologies to enhance operational efficiency and customer experience. The Group also focuses on prudent financial management, talent development, and deepening Party building to support sustainable high-quality development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through fees from property management services, including basic management and value-added services, community living services such as group buying and equipment provision, asset management services including leasing and sales, and community operation services like advertising and venue rental. The company recognizes revenue based on contracted gross floor area under management and service delivery to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Evergrande Property Services is one of the largest integrated property management enterprises in China, ranked among the top listed property management companies by scale and operational stability. It competes in a highly competitive market with other leading property management firms, leveraging its diversified service offerings, technological integration, and presence in key urban markets to maintain a strong industry position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, the Group reported revenue of approximately RMB12.76 billion, representing a 2.2% year-on-year increase. The net profit was approximately RMB1.03 billion, with a decrease compared to the prior year due to various operational challenges. The Group manages a gross floor area under management of about 579 million square meters, showing steady scale growth. It maintains a robust cash position with no borrowings and continues to improve its financial stability despite market pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Evergrande emphasizes customer-centric, high-quality property services enhanced by technological innovation such as AIoT-enabled smart security and digital platforms for seamless service delivery. It differentiates through comprehensive service offerings spanning basic management to value-added living services, community engagement, and asset management. The company’s focus on service quality, safety, and community value-added services aims to improve residents’ living experiences and foster customer satisfaction and loyalty.
